packageRules.description: Label majors so they stand out; read the release notes before merging
Kotlin is held below 2.4.20: the CodeQL extractor refuses anything newer and the Kotlin security scan then silently stops running. Lift when CodeQL supports it (commit c82af88).
nextcloud/ocp major follows the supported Nextcloud range (31-34, see appinfo/info.xml and the CI matrix). Bump deliberately when that range changes.
dbal 4 needs PHP 8.2 and the app supports PHP 8.1; it is also only the dev-time typing for the Nextcloud 31 baseline.
phpunit 11+ needs PHP 8.2 or newer (13 needs 8.4) and the app supports PHP 8.1.
@nextcloud/webpack-vue-config declares a peer dependency on webpack-cli ^6; lift when it allows 7.
4.1.0 fails the webpack build (cannot resolve node-stdlib-browser/cjs/proxy/process); lift when fixed upstream.
